scope: Fixed prepared mother inputs and the separately reviewed v15 assembled runtime derivative. Historical 20261107 rejected sources are not the current-source verdict.

head.geometry: Actual complete High skull and neck, uniform normalization and root translation; no cropped posterior cranium.
head.coat: Replacement UVs, short russet coat and white throat; source face color retained. Diffuse and tangent normals rebaked on the High mother. Reconstructed assembly later removes these old tangent maps.

tail.geometry: Actual High vertices reshaped into a round axial envelope; no Medium final geometry. Prepared mother has 24990 vertices and 49976 faces after disclosed offline cleanup.
tail.coat: Reviewed Medium derivative supplies only color through exact triangle-hit UV sampling. Its positions, normals and draw topology are not used as final geometry. Donor is packaged separately to reproduce this color transfer. Solid cream tips are applied during assembly bake.

body.geometry: Native complete four-paw body. No transplanted paw geometry and no old cropped-paw audit used as a current-source verdict.

assembly.geometry: Offline voxel union at 1.8mm, local muscular root relaxation and decimation ratio .07 form a new derivative surface, not untouched High topology. Complete skulls and four native paws remain represented.

rootRefinement.method: Clay-confirmed groove fairing, confined to two 19cm basal neighborhoods including adjoining body skin; topology and vertices outside those neighborhoods unchanged
rootRefinement.rejectedTrials: Radial growth v13/v14 made pedestal-like bases and was rejected; final v15 uses bounded fairing only

assembly.coat: 4096 atlas from exact nearest source triangle, barycentric UV/bilinear linear-color samples and conservative rasterization including subpixel charts; native High face-detail bake blended only on upper neck/skull. Body-derived root blend 17cm on necks, 14.5cm on tails, extended to 23cm only on tails 06/09. Original source tangent maps removed on reconstructed topology.

topologyLimitation.claim: A connected main skin with tiny residual source fragments; not claimed to be an exactly single-component watertight mesh

assembly.inferred: Four-leg count, each head's fox face, organ arrangement, root musculature, colors, tail markings and all movement are artistic interpretations. Classical text requires fox form, nine heads, nine tails and tiger claws.

build.result: exit 0; actual prepare -> rig -> compress output is byte-identical to the independently accepted v15 candidate
build.environment: Repository pnpm lockfile; Blender 5.2.3 with bundled numpy; glTF Transform 4.5.1. Run Blender from repository cwd with --background --factory-startup --disable-autoexec --python-exit-code 1. No paid API requests are part of this build.
build.compression: Common build script defaults: Meshopt high, WebP2048, simplify/flatten/join/instance/palette false. Default weld/resample remain enabled; compression quantization is measured, not claimed lossless.

runtime.stance: Inverse circular XYZ foot targets and full sole yaw; runtime root follows the matching circle and camera translates with it. Four rigid distal paws, complete skulls protected, special returns to idle.
runtime.ownership: SkeletonUtils clones cached scene; effect-owned ink/outline, mixer and skeleton resources clean up; three actual remounts keep cached graph unchanged and shared resource disposal count zero.

followCameraCleanup.method: Accumulate only owned world-path translation, subtract from shared camera and controls target on unmount, then clear.
followCameraCleanup.independentParentVerification: Two 120s walks, switching to Jiuweihu with real Longzhi remount; monotonic actual R3F clock, 4800 finite walk steps.

repositoryChecks.command: pnpm typecheck && pnpm validate && pnpm build && pnpm qa:browser

verification.thresholdsUnchanged: World stance <0.7mm; sole vertical <0.7mm; sole shape <1mm; skull drift <1mm; localized relative edge strain <.80; loops <1mm. Failed v4-v9 candidates retained separately; no action amplitude or threshold reduction to pass.

fullOrbitUi.method: 384 all-deformed-vertex projection samples per screen, actual R3F steps, 6.2972835 radians; 8px safety.

verification.narration: Existing longzhi.mp3 reused; actual playback advancement and stop verified. No new TTS generation or new narration claimed.

beastCall.method: Existing procedural infantCry triggered once by special after audio unlock; actual sfx analyser signal verified

verification.visualReview: Worker personally Read final v15 four views, clay root before/after and actual ink shoulder/nape/rump. Parent separately Read and accepted static anatomy and final v15 ink/root material gates. Thin root outlines accepted as natural occlusion; no outline suppression applied.
